notes.title: HotFix v1.2 - IMPROVING PERFORMANCE & BUILT IN POPULAR CONTROLLERS
notes.notes:
[h2]HotFix v1.2[/h2]

[h3]Bugs;[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed the "Play Game" button not appearing for some players.
[*] Vairous bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Performance;[/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved the performance of AMD based graphics cards.
[*] Improved the overall performance of the game on low end PCs.
[*] Added DirectX12 launch version of the game.
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Controller;[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added easy to setup any controller and configure easily.
[*] Added more controller settings. (Steer Sensitivity, Throtle Sensitivity, Break Sensitivity etc.).
[*] Added popular controller support to the game. It is designed for you to use as plug and play.
[/list]


[h3]Added Ready Controllers;[/h3]

[list]
[*] Logitech G25
[*] Logitech G27
[*] Logitech G29
[*] Logitech G920
[*] Logitech Driving Force GT
[*] Logitech MOMO
[*] Thrustmaster FFB
[*] Thrustmaster T100
[*] Thrustmaster T150
[*] Thrustmaster T300 RS
[*] Thrustmaster T500 RS
[/list]
